step.cmd: If the decision involves a RFS, determine if the ROE is on file:

ul.li: If no, go to step 3.
If yes, in RCM, update the Special condition field to reflect the reconsideration decision on the RFS.

step.cmd: Create an AI WI as follows:

ul.li: Urgent: Check the box.
Complexity: Select Level 1 .
Claim type: Select Revised .
Destination — Level: Select EI Processing .
End User: Select Next available user .
Category: Select Pay affected .
Issue: Select Calculation .
Comments: Type “Level 1 recalculation required — Integrity case [Integrity case number].”

Details: Do the following:
Type “A recalculation of BPC [DD-MM-YYYY] is required due to the adjudication of ROE [serial number]. A Level 2 ROD is on file and the reconsideration timeframe ends on [DD-MM-YYYY]. Recalculation inputs and notification to the client must be completed no later than this date. The infraction code for the recalculation is W - Insurability. ” If the ROE contains false information, clearly indicate what is incorrect and provide the correct information. If there is a CR Recalculation WI for the ROE under reconsideration, also type “Complete the Claim Review Recalculation work item related to this benefits period.”

step.cmd: Create a client Note and do the following:

ul.li: Type “Please indicate in the client Note the transaction fields and data to be entered for the recalculation of the [blocked or archived] claim so that this information can be included with the unclassified violation on the Operational Centre Memo (MM06). The [D-91-00-00 or D-17-03-00] letter will be sent once the claim has been recalculated. Please save any other required letters.”

step.cmd: Move the CR Integrity WI to Pending as follows:

ul.li: Pending reason: Select Other .
Comments: Type“MM06 to be sent once recalculation transaction inputs indicated in client Note.”
Bring forward date: Select the next business day.

step.cmd: When the CR Integrity WI moves to the current workload, verify that recalculation transactions are indicated in the client Note:

ul.li: If the recalculation transactions are not indicated in the client Note , return to step 5.
If the transactions fields and data to be entered for the recalculation are indicated in the client Note , go to step 7.

step.cmd: In FTS, select the Renewal/Revised (M106) transaction to create an Operational Centre Memo (MM06) as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the revised registration corresponding to the investigation.
Select Memo (MPS) .

Infraction: Select the appropriate option:
For a false ROE, select W - Fraud - Insurability - new information .
For a contentious RFS, select Z - Fraud – Other .

Message: Select the appropriate option:
For a contentious RFS, select 1 - An overpayment resulted due to a disqualification .
For a false ROE, select 9 - An overpayment resulted due to a change in insurable employment .
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select D - No .
Select Update .

step.cmd: When the Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction opens, send the information to IPOC as follows:

ul.li: Registration number: Select the revised registration number corresponding to the investigation.
BPC: Select the BPC of the claim on which the misrepresentation was made.
Work item: Select 91 - Overpayment .
Work type: Select 1 - Misrepresentation .

Remarks line 1: Indicate all of the following that are applicable:
Whether additional information is being provided on another Operational Centre Memo (MM06) transaction. (e.g. Page 1 of 3, Page 2 of 3)
URGENT: If urgent, provide reason. (e.g. URGENT approaching time limitation)
Indicate the exact transaction fields and data to be entered for the recalculation (from the client Note ). (e.g. M106 BPC___ HOURS___ EARNINGS____.)

Remarks line 2 : Indicate all of the following:
WRN: warning letter
LMR: first, second or third level of misrepresentation
VLN: unclassified violation information (V-1-1-1)
Integrity case number
Example

Remarks line 3: Type one of the following instructions for the ACS letter:
Send stored [D-17-03-00 or D-91-00-00] letter.
Add [missing fields] to [D-17-03-00 or D-91-00-00] letter and send.
Amend [D-17-03-00 or D-91-00-00] letter if applicable (re: reconsideration limitation) and send.
Remarks line 5: Enter your first name and last name.
Contentious: Select 2 - Yes .
Complete: Select C - Yes .
Select Update .
If it is a contentious RFS, go to step 10.
If it is a false ROE or an ROE containing false information, go to step 11.

step.cmd: In ACS, create and save the D-91-00-00 letter to inform the client of the reconsideration, warning letter and unclassified violation decisions. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li: Decision reconsidered beyond 36 months (2595): Select the appropriate option.
Indefinite disqualification - D11 or D10 - Post audit (2915)
Various reasons for penalty and violation : Found work / Self Employment / Capability / Training / Availability / Full work week / Text(2935)
No reply from client/reply received with an explanation/reply received with no explanation (2938)
False representation message/Number of omissions or false representations (2941)
Levels of misrepresentation (12292)
Penalty message / Warning message (2950): Select Warning message .
Overpayment Messages (2452)
Notice of violation (3095)
Go to step 12.

step.cmd: In ACS, create and save the D-17-03-00 letter to inform the client of the reconsideration and unclassified violation decisions. Based on the claim information, select all of the required attributes, including the following:

ul.li:
False ROE(s) / False Information (2618): Select the appropriate option.
Number of invalid or false ROE(s) submitted (1668)
Specify serial number of invalid or false ROE(s) (1672)
Levels of Misrepresentation (12292): Select the level of misrepresentation and number of false representations.
Penalty message / Warning message (2950): Select Warning message .
Overpayment Messages (2452)
Notice of violation (3095)

step.cmd: In NWS, clear the client Note .
Determine if a sanction also applies to a third party:

ul.li: If yes, go to Implementing third party misrepresentation to impose the sanctions on the third party and to complete the case. Implementing third party misrepresentation
If no, go to step 14.

step.cmd: In NIIS, on the Decision tab of the Report of Investigation (IC50 or IC70) screen, clear the case as follows:

ul.li:
Overpayment: Indicate whether an OP resulted from the misrepresentation.
Reason: Select the appropriate option based on the decision that resulted in the OP.
Amount: Enter the estimated total net OP that resulted from the misrepresentation.
Penalty: Select No .

Warning: Select Yes .
Reason: Select the appropriate option.

Violation: Select Yes .
Seriousness: Select Warning .
